subject: Incubator cohort: seat surcharge, promo credits, and packaging options
messages:
From: Kate O'Neill <kate@rocketfoundry.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: promo carveout for Rocket Foundry cohort (early July)

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team at Rocket Foundry is excited about using Redwood for inference during our next cohort. We have a couple of asks as we finalize the program package and wanted to see if Redwood can support an exception:  

- We have 30 participating startups for the July cohort; the standard incubator package caps at 20 seats. Is there a seat surcharge or a packaging path to cover the +10 seats without pushing us into the enterprise tiers?
- Several startups requested extra free credits to run initial prototypes. Can you approve a one-time promo pool increase (we're asking for +50% credits on top of the standard 6-month stipend)?

We understand there may be commercial implications. If helpful, I've attached a quick cost model for the cohort (RF_Proposed_Pricing_Q3.xlsx). Also looping Tom (procurement) who will handle the PO/contract side.

Goal: confirm pricing and packaging by Friday so we can include the terms in the cohort welcome packet.

Thanks,
Kate
Kate O'Neill
Head of Programs, Rocket Foundry
kate@rocketfoundry.com

Attachments: RF_Proposed_Pricing_Q3.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Kate O'Neill <kate@rocketfoundry.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: promo carveout for Rocket Foundry cohort (early July)

Hi Kate — appreciate the context and the model.

Short answer: we can be flexible, but I want to outline options so we don't accidentally move you into a pricing band that increases unit cost for startups. Two quick options that could work: 

1) Cohort overlay (recommended): keep the incubator package, add a one-off +10 seat overlay at a flat per-seat surcharge (not the enterprise minimum). That keeps per-startup economics predictable. I can propose $300/extra-seat (one-time) and we waive the onboarding setup fee for the additional seats.

2) Promo pool uplift + contractual milestone: increase the shared promo credits by 50% for 6 months, but require a short mutual-action plan (MAP) with two milestones (demo day & program survey) in exchange for the uplift. This lets us justify the promotional expense.

Both require a short addendum to the MSA (we can use the redlines flow). Per our process, anything that changes the credit pool needs a commercial sign-off from Ben and program approval from Marissa. I've attached a template overlay we commonly use.

Can you confirm (a) whether Rocket Foundry prefers seat surcharge or promo uplift, and (b) if you can commit to the two MAP milestones? If you want, we can do a quick 20-min sync today.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0173

Attachments: RF_Proposed_Pricing_Q3.xlsx (referenced)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kate O'Neill <kate@rocketfoundry.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: promo carveout for Rocket Foundry cohort (early July)

Soojin — thanks for the clear options. My read: overlay + waived onboarding is simplest and minimizes our promo burn. A couple of internal notes for approval: 

- If we do the +10 seat overlay at $300/seat one-time, that's $3k ARR-equivalent one-off; acceptable for AM/BD to approve.
- If they want the promo pool uplift (50%), that'll need a discount exception; recommend we cap uplift to 40% unless Marissa signs off on 50% given current promo budget.

Marissa — can you confirm program-level approval for either: (A) seat overlay + waived onboarding (no promo uplift), or (B) seat overlay + 40–50% promo uplift with MAP? If (B), we should require the MAP deliverables to be added to the HubSpot deal and set an expiry on the promo credits (90 days post-demo-day).

Ben Carter
Director, Growth | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Subject: Approval: one-time cohort exception (Rocket Foundry)

Thanks for the context — I reviewed the attached proposal and the ask aligns with our partner accelerator budget. Approved with the following conditions: 

1) Approve seat overlay: +10 seats at $300/seat one-time (invoiceable). Waive onboarding fee for those seats.
2) Approve promo uplift: one-time +50% promo credits for the shared cohort pool, expiring 90 days after demo day.
3) Require a short addendum to the MSA ("Cohort Overlay Addendum") capturing seat surcharge, promo uplift, MAP milestones, and expiry. Legal has prepared a redline. I've attached the redlined MSA excerpt (MSA_redwood_v3_redlines.pdf).
4) Accounting request: mark the uplift as promotional expense; revenue recognized when seat surcharge payment is received. Ben — please update HubSpot and set the promo expiry date field (90 days post-demo).

I'll approve the ask on the condition that Kate signs the addendum and Tom (procurement) issues the PO. Once signed, we can auto-provision the additional seats and increase the shared credits pool.

Marissa Cole
Head, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: MSA_redwood_v3_redlines.pdf (PDF, 124KB)
